title: A weekly timetable: what repeats each week, day by day, with its time, places left and a way to book
about: Classes, rehearsals, practices, surgeries, opening sessions: rows that come back every week on a weekday at a time. Each day of the week lists its rows in time order with who leads it and where, and, with a bookings table, how many places are left on that date and a Book button (Full when none are). Arrows go to other weeks. Choose it whenever the request lists weekly classes or a schedule people book into.

table.about: the table of the weekly rows

key.about: names the pattern's data and state

day.about: the column with the weekday (Monday, mon, or 0 for Sunday to 6)

time.about: the column with the start time ('HH:MM')

minutes.about: the column with how long it lasts in minutes (optional)

sub.about: a column with who leads it

place.about: a column with where it is

spaces.about: the column with how many places it has

bookings.about: the table of bookings (a row per place taken)

of.about: the bookings column holding the row's id

date.about: the bookings column with the date booked ('YYYY-MM-DD')

open.about: the view the button opens with {id, date}

call.about: the function the button calls with {id, date}

$value.sql: SELECT {{of}} AS c, {{date}} AS d, COUNT(*) AS n FROM {{bookings}} WHERE days_between(:start, {{date}}) BETWEEN 0 AND 6 GROUP BY {{of}}, {{date}} LIMIT 2000

let.{{key}}_idx: =v => { if (v == null || v === '') return -1; if (/^\\d$/.test(String(v))) return Number(v) % 7; return ['sun', 'mon', 'tue', 'wed', 'thu', 'fri', 'sat'].indexOf(String(v).trim().slice(0, 3).toLowerCase()); }
let.{{key}}_left: =(r, d) => { if (!{{spaces|json}} || r[{{spaces|json}}] == null) return null; const t = (data[{{key|json}} + '_taken'] || []).find(x => String(x.c) === String(r.id) && String(x.d).slice(0, 10) === d); return Math.max(0, Number(r[{{spaces|json}}]) - (t ? Number(t.n) : 0)); }
let.{{key}}_days: =[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map(i => { const d = lib.dates.addDays({{key}}_start, i); const w = lib.dates.weekday(d); return {day: d, label: lib.dates.weekdayName(d) + ' ' + app.fmt.date(d), today: d === today, past: d < today, rows: ({{key}} || []).filter(r => {{key}}_idx(r[{{day|json}}]) === w).map(r => ({r, left: {{key}}_left(r, d)}))}; })
let.{{key}}_go: =(r, d) => {{open|json}} ? app.open({{open|json}}, {id: r.id, date: d}) : {{call|json}} ? app.call({{call|json}}, {id: r.id, date: d}).then(() => app.toast('Booked')) : null
